title: 1997 Pacific Philadelphia Gold #53 John Elway Denver Broncos Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1997 Pacific Philadelphia sports trading card features John Elway, the legendary quarterback for the Denver Broncos. The card is part of the Philadelphia insert set and has a gold parallel/variety, making it a highly sought-after item for collectors. The card number is 53 and it is from the 1997 season.

This rare and valuable card is a must-have for any fan of football and the National Football League (NFL). It is manufactured by Pacific and is a type of sports trading card. The card is packed with exciting features, including the insert set and the golden parallel/variety. Don't miss out on this opportunity to add this gem to your collection!
